name: keeping-up-with-agents
description: Answer questions about AI conference talks, speakers, and concepts from this repo's event-indexed wikis (events/<event>/wiki/). Install once; every event added under events/ becomes queryable automatically. Currently indexed: AI Engineer World's Fair 2026 (256 talks, 134 concepts, 276 speakers) and Y Combinator Startup School 2026 (14 talks, 36 concepts, 14 speakers). No RAG server, no vector DB, just the link graph plus grep.
